AlarmTakeover.description: An alarm going off: its time and label, big, until it's dismissed.
AlarmTakeover.title: AlarmTakeover

Backup.description:
Everything Settings can change, as one file — photos, keys and the
server's own config.toml aside.
Backup.title: Backup

CameraTakeover.title: CameraTakeover

CustomColours.description:
What the menu's theme maker asks for: a background, an accent, the
main card colours and, optionally, a typeface. Text colours are worked
out from these. Most cards borrow the weather colour; the retired phrase
card's defaults to the quote card's.
CustomColours.title: CustomColours

Grid.description:
A hand-placed layout from the layout builder: each card snapped to a
cell rectangle on a ``cols``-wide grid. Rows are however many the cards
reach. A screen without one keeps the automatic card_stack flow.
Grid.title: Grid

ImageSearchTakeover.description:
A visual collage of image search results, tiled in an interlocking
mosaic layout with letter badges (A, B, C...) for voice-guided inspection.
ImageSearchTakeover.title: ImageSearchTakeover

PhotoClock.description:
How the Photo Clock draws the time over the photos (web
cards/PhotoClock.svelte). Mirrors PhotoClockSettings in
web/src/lib/clockface.svelte.ts.
PhotoClock.title: PhotoClock

RecipeTakeover.description:
A recipe. Ingredient indexes count lines across the groups, in the
order they're listed here; ones past the end are ignored.
RecipeTakeover.title: RecipeTakeover

ScreenLook.description:
The bits of a screen's look that live in its own browser (launch-URL
flags and localStorage), reported so the phone menu's live miniature can
draw it the same way.
ScreenLook.title: ScreenLook

ScreenPrefs.description:
The household's, profile's and screen's preferences the client applies
itself — formatting, timings, the night clock's hours.
ScreenPrefs.title: ScreenPrefs

ScreenView.description: A device as the phone menu lists it.
ScreenView.title: ScreenView

TakeoverUpdate.description:
What's being read on the card that's up. Only the fields sent change;
the rest keep their values.
TakeoverUpdate.title: TakeoverUpdate
